title: 蕾欧娜·向日葵午后
description: 红棕发蕾欧娜穿完整金甲，坐在阳光里托起小向日葵盆，剑盾安放支架。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Leona is an adult Solari knight with long auburn hair, a gold sun-shaped forehead ornament, warm eyes, and broad golden armor plates. Preserve her fully armored torso, covered legs, gauntlets, and boots, with a red cloth accent. Her straight sword remains sheathed and her large ornate sun shield rests securely on a floor stand, both static and clearly recognizable.
art_direction.scene: She sits on a broad stone bench and holds a small sunflower pot in both gauntlets, turning the bloom toward a warm patch of sunlight. A plain watering cup sits beside the bench. One arch and a soft curtain echo the sun shape, with the shield and sheathed sword quietly displayed behind her.
art_direction.palette: sunflower gold, auburn, warm ivory, pale sky blue
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
